notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the Dean of the Faculty 'Faculty Leaves' page.

Governing document: 2018_00_link, the Dean of the Faculty (Arts & Sciences) 'Faculty Leaves' page, states the tenure-track maternity and parental leaves in entitlement language ('is entitled to') and is read as the faculty leave policy in force (the no-policy coding (`missing`) condition not met, so missing is false). The Handbook of the Faculty of Arts & Sciences, which it names ('contains the policies, regulations and benefits within Arts & Sciences') and to which the HR page refers faculty, is not saved: flagged cross_reference_not_saved on c1 and c2.

Scope: the policy page belongs to the Dean of the Faculty of Arts & Sciences; the saved documents do not mention an engineering school, so V3 cannot be checked for engineering. faculty_scope records the scope on c1-c5; faculty_group kept as the code.

Other provisions on the faculty page that are not components (a parent could not use them for the birth): Junior Faculty Fellowships, Senior Faculty Grants, Sabbaticals, Prestigious Awards, Research Leave (RESL), and Leaves of Absence without Compensation (LOC), which are granted 'to enable faculty members to pursue professional activities outside of Dartmouth'. The HR page's unpaid LOA (purpose unstated) is coded as c12, general_purpose.

HR page: the STD plan is for staff (Non-Exempt, Exempt, SEIU); 'Faculty members, please refer to the faculty handbook' (c11, excludes_main_faculty). Its PARENTAL LEAVE links ('Maternity Leave', 'Paid Paternal Leave') and FMLA forms are not saved.

Calendar: quarters ('the quarter during or immediately after the birth'; 'faculty members normally teach three out of four terms'), term length not stated: calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order.

Birth parent chain: maternity leave c1 (1 term, the quarter of or after the birth) -> parental leave c2 (1 term, consecutive_after c1); FMLA c8 12 workweeks alongside from the start of c1 (concurrent_with c1 and c2); separately, medical leave c4 (up to 6 months) with its pay c5 within it, then LTD c6 consecutive_after c5 (no duration); not linked to the maternity chain.
Non-birth parent chain: parental leave c2 (1 term, primary care-provider) with FMLA c8 alongside from its start (concurrent_with c2); the c2->c1 link is ignored for this role.

Not determined by the documents: the pay level of the faculty medical leave (c5); whether tenure-track faculty accrue vacation or personal leave (c10); the length of the lecturers' maternity leave in time (c3: one course only); whether the parental leave's primary care-provider condition is assessed against a partner.
